info.title: RoadGuard API
info.description: Persisted inspections using explicit demo scenarios or the locally installed released detector. Inspection responses contain at most one box; raw evidence is retained internally. Uploads return only inspection_id, status, detection and task_id; details are queried separately. Real primary detections meeting the configured confidence threshold (default 0.60) create one task. Lower-confidence detections require review; business rules and tasks remain demo assumptions. Road type is user-declared. Four-crew Greedy/GA route plans use the configured travel matrix (labelled simulated by default, or Google Routes when enabled) and demo shift/objective assumptions; recalculation is explicit and never automatic. The separate /demo endpoints remain stateless previews.

patch.summary: Change crew availability; increments input_revision and marks existing plans stale
patch.description: Does not compute a new plan. Call POST /route-plans/recalculate with the returned input_revision. Retrying with the same request_id replays the stored outcome.

post.summary: Plan all active tasks with Greedy and GA on the same input and matrix, then save both
post.description: expected_revision must equal the current input_revision. If tasks or crews change during calculation, nothing is saved and 409 stale_input_revision is returned. Travel times come from the configured provider: the labelled simulated matrix (matrix_is_simulated=true) or Google Routes computeRouteMatrix. If Google fails, 503 travel_matrix_unavailable is returned, nothing is saved and there is no fallback to simulated times.
